title: Cosmos DB
description: Use Cosmos DB for NoSQL data with global distribution.

data.text: Cosmos DB is a globally distributed NoSQL database. Choose API (SQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, Table, Gremlin), configure consistency, and use change feed.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Cosmos DB provides globally distributed NoSQL with multiple APIs. Choose consistency level based on use case and design partition keys carefully.
